The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a high-tier weapon, which inflicts {{Health|-|25}} of damage to enemies, while only consuming {{Energy|-|1}}. It can either be crafted at the [[jewelry table]], or purchased from [[Koukol]] near the [[mountain fort]].

One of these weapons may be acquired from [[Krezvold]] when progressing through the DLC [[Stranger sins]]. He may arrive outside [[Sweet Home]] and hurriedly give one to the player, claiming that he was supposed to melt it and now a crime was committed in [[the Town]] with this very sword.

Note: When giving the sword to [[Snake]], the player cannot have the sword equipped.

== Uses ==
It is the strongest sword in the game so it has its uses in Combat and the [[Dungeon]].

One is needed to progress with [[Snake]] to commence with the Ritual in the [[Sacrifice Zone]].
